title: Quad Setting Iso-Contraction
instructions: Lie flat with towel under knee. Tighten thigh muscle pushing back of knee into towel for 5 seconds.
clinicalNotes: Safely reactivates VMO muscle fibers following ACL or knee arthroscopy without joint rotational shear.

title: Seated Pendulum Shoulder Swings
instructions: Lean forward over table, let affected arm hang down passively, gently sway arm in small circles.
clinicalNotes: Maintains humerus synovial fluid circulation following rotator cuff repair.
